headline: A federal law renames a Brooksville, Florida post office building after Specialist Justin Dean Coleman.
what_it_does: The law officially names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 207 East Fort Dade Avenue in Brooksville, Florida, the Specialist Justin Dean Coleman Memorial Post Office Building. It changes only the name of the building and does not change how the post office operates. The official summary does not describe any other changes.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 2, 2025.
